name: BG-series droid
description: BG-series droids were a model of assassin droid. An older model by the time of the New Republic, it was believed that all examples of the droid had been destroyed. At least one droid, BG-12, survived and was in the service of the criminal Themog.

data.name: BG-series droid
data.armament: Two blaster pistols in arm recesses
